subject: Observability kickoff — dashboards, traces, and alert routing
messages:
From: Claire Diaz <claire.diaz@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability kickoff — dashboards, traces, and alert routing

Hi Olga / Laura —

Thanks for taking this on. We're ready to move from discovery to a hands-on kickoff for observability at ClearWater. High-level goals from our side:

- Surface end-to-end latency for our patient ingestion pipeline (expected 99th pct < 350ms).
- Tie user-facing errors to trace spans and a service-level error taxonomy for quicker TTR.
- Get a minimal alert-routing scheme so ops gets P0/P1 paging and CS sees degraded user-impact.

We attached a brief tech stack and a first-pass SLOs sheet so you can see our environment. Can you confirm the following ahead of the workshop?

1) Recommended pre-kickoff artifacts you need from us (log samples, service map, sample traces).
2) A proposed 90-minute kickoff agenda (we prefer Tuesdays or Thursdays next week 10–2 PT).
3) Quick note on whether you recommend trace sampling at 100% for the ingestion path during the pilot.

Attachments: ClearWater_TechStack_v2.pdf, Initial_SLOs.xlsx

Thanks — Claire
Claire Diaz
Principal Engineer, ClearWater Health
claire.diaz@clearwaterhealth.com

From: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Diaz <claire.diaz@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability kickoff — dashboards, traces, and alert routing

Claire —

Appreciate the clarity and the attachments. We're excited to get this moving. Proposed pre-kickoff checklist (short):

- Service map (simple diagram: ingestion -> validation -> enrichment -> store)
- 48–72 hours of representative logs (JSON lines or gzipped) from ingestion and enrichment services
- Sample trace spans if available (OpenTelemetry format is best)
- Who should be on the 90-minute call (list of SMEs)

Draft 90-minute kickoff agenda (we'll refine on the call):
1) Introductions & success metrics (10m)
2) Architecture walkthrough (10m)
3) Live log + trace sampling (20m)
4) Dashboard requirements & quick wins (20m)
5) Error taxonomy & alert routing decisions (20m)
6) Next steps & action owners (10m)

On sampling: for the ingestion pipeline I typically recommend 100% sampling for the first 48 hours of the pilot (to build the baseline), then move to adaptive sampling for steady state. We'll discuss tradeoffs on the call.

I've looped in Ben (CS) and Sean (SRE) — Ben will run the onboarding logistics and Sean can speak to instrumentation patterns and alerts.

Quick ask: can you upload a short service map + one day's logs to the shared Drive link in the related_links? We'll prepare a runbook template ahead of time (RI-Runbook-Template.docx).

Olga Petrov

Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability kickoff — dashboards, traces, and alert routing

Ben / Olga —

17 Jun at 10:00 PT works for us. We'll upload a one-day logs tarball and a simple service map by Friday. A couple of quick technical questions to add to the agenda:

- We're using OpenTelemetry (Go + Python) with Jaeger in staging and CloudWatch logs in prod. Any Redwood pre-built dashboards for Jaeger traces?
- For error taxonomy, we currently mix HTTP 5xx, validation errors, and domain errors under a single alert → we want to split user-impacting vs. background-processing failures. Best practice?
- On sampling: ingestion path can be 100% for 48–72 hours for the pilot; enrichment can be 10% to start. Is that consistent with Redwood recommendations?

Quoted from Olga's note: "On sampling: for the ingestion pipeline I typically recommend 100% sampling for the first 48 hours of the pilot (to build the baseline), then move to adaptive sampling for steady state." — that aligns with our thinking.

See you on the 17th. I'll ensure Mark (CTO) is on the call for the architecture portion.

Cheers,
Claire

All —

Great — confirmed: Kickoff scheduled for Tue, 17 Jun 2025 10:00 PT. Calendar invite + Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890. Agenda updated slightly to reflect Claire's questions. Final agenda (90m):

1) Introductions & success metrics (10m) — Claire, Mark, Olga
2) Architecture & instrumentation review (15m) — ClearWater + Sean
3) Live trace and log walkthrough (20m) — Claire (samples) + Sean (how Redwood ingests)
4) Dashboard quick wins (15m) — demo of a pre-built Jaeger trace dashboard + token-level cost check
5) Error taxonomy design (15m) — split: user-impacting vs background processing; map to page vs ticket
6) Alert routing run-through (10m) — on-call + CS escalation path
7) Runbook handoff & next steps (5m)

Action owners (short):
- Claire / ClearWater: upload one-day logs + service map to Drive by Fri 13 Jun EOD (Claire) — pending
